name: Missile variant tint
description: Lets a missile whose HD JSON has a VariantDefinitionComponent use that variant's color tint, like monsters do, on its models and on its particle effects. Missiles have no TransLvl, so they always use the level0 entry of their variant file.

patches.description: Gate 1: a missile model enters the color block only when the missile has a variant component ([rbp-60h] not null). mov edx,8 becomes push 8/pop rdx to make room, so the call to sub_140EE69A0 moves up 2 bytes.
Gate 2: monsters (type 1) keep their own color index from sub_14009A530; missiles (type 3) get index 2 (level0); players (type 0) still skip.

Particle tint, cave: code in the unreachable branch at 0xEAC12E (it only runs when the constant string "ColorVariantIndex" is empty). Monsters (type 1) continue exactly as before; missiles (type 3) set the variant's current index to 2 (level0) when it is still 0, then continue like a monster; every other type skips as before.
Particle tint, hook: the per-frame pass that writes ColorVariantIndex to every effect of a unit (sub_140EABFC0) only accepted monster definitions (cmp [r8+168h],1). Jump to the cave instead.
